business_problem: Focused on innovation and product development, Florida Crystals Corporation is a joint owner of ASR Group International, the world’s largest refiner and marketer of cane sugar with operations in the United States, Canada, Mexico, Belize, the United Kingdom, Portugal, and Italy. The company produces a full line of grocery, industrial, food service, and specialty sweetener products.
